items.title: Ernest McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: And Homer Eugene. Two favorite guitar players around town.

ctx.x: Did you ever hear of Charlie Christian in person or just on the record?

I didn't get a chance, I was unfortunate. Yeah, I did. And Charlie Christian died just before I went to country in the service. And, well in town, Buddy Charles, Irvin Charles is his name. I used to admire him, admire him play with Cindy Desby. And Homer Eugene. Two favorite guitar players around town.
Did you ever take any lessons from them?
